name: husqvarna-feature-flags-harness
description: Full-stack vertical slice for Feature Flags & Audit Trail (Husqvarna Senior Full Stack Engineer Assessment)

scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.migrate: docker compose -f Docker/docker-compose.yml exec backend npm run db:migrate
scripts.migrate:undo: docker compose -f Docker/docker-compose.yml exec backend npm run db:migrate:undo
scripts.seed: docker compose -f Docker/docker-compose.yml exec backend npm run db:seed
scripts.seed:undo: docker compose -f Docker/docker-compose.yml exec backend npm run db:seed:undo

author: Ashish
